evidence.quote: This profile compares P.TRANSACTION_ID to the identical T.TRANSACTION_ID string. It compares the pair (M.TRANSACTION_ID, M.PROCESS_ID) to the identical pair in P. Comparisons are literal string-value lookups in the supplied CSV snapshots.
These lookups do not assume a target has exactly one row, do not equate RETRY_COUNT across files, and do not establish a required child, a foreign-key contract, or an operational business obligation.
